title: L'évolution créatrice
author: Henri Bergson
current_text: In 1914, L'évolution créatrice was placed on the Roman Catholic Church’s Index of prohibited books.

sources.quote: In 1914, Creative Evolution (1907) was placed on the Roman Catholic Church’s Index of prohibited books, alongside Bergson’s earlier works, Time and Free Will (1889) and Matter and Memory (1896).
sources.title: Bergson, Pan(en)theism, and ‘Being-in-Life’ - PMC
